summary: Matternet, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a reverse merger where shell company Los Altos Ventures Corp. acquired private Matternet, Inc., with the registrant being the combined entity. The filing includes departures of legacy directors/officers, change in control, amendment of articles, accounting change, and change in shell status. No specific per-share price, premium, or deal value was disclosed. The registrant ceased to be a shell company. Watch for subsequent integration updates and possible future financings; this is a de-SPAC-like transaction without a traditional SPAC structure.
